scene: The pulled string unfurls a grand transit map overhead.
picture: A flat side view of a bustling multi-level transit plaza. In the centre, the bearded man in his blue flat cap and orange cardigan grips his cane, looking upward. On the left sits a sleek blue monorail car at a platform. Up high rests a tilted wooden funicular car. On the right, a striped water taxi waits.
shown: A sleek blue monorail car waiting at a platform on the left
A wooden funicular railway car stopped on an inclined track up high
A striped water taxi bobbing beside a wooden dock on the right
